sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with user mascot reference. Short neatly side-parted/swept black hair with a few grey highlights and dark eyebrows; distinct compact dark moustache immediately above the single restrained closed mouth, otherwise no distinct full beard. Mostly frontal head with slight screen-left turn/gaze; no hat, spectacles or smoking accessory. Blue-grey notched suit jacket, pale cream shirt collar and plain dark-brown tie; shoulders/chest cropped at lower/side edges, entire hairstyle in frame. Soft upper-left facial light, complete smoky dark-grey gradient background continuous to all four edges, no photo card, separate frame, note or handwriting. Measured alpha253..255 is near-opaque source variation, not an exterior cutout or permission to remove the painted rectangle. Individual moustache strands, fine weave and subtle jaw stubble versus skin shading cannot be securely specified from the source; retain the clearly visible moustache/hair/brows without inventing beard. Description follows visible-source-differences-v1; no unsupported tiny-feature match asserted.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Short thick swept-back wavy dark hair/grey highlights, dark hairy brows, round dark-rim spectacles with clear reflective lenses, thin curled dark moustache and a small dark chin/soul-patch area. Slight smiling parted single mouth with a narrow pale central lip/tooth glint; exact tooth segmentation is unreadable and must not be invented or enlarged into a grin. Three-quarter head/gaze toward screen-right. Brown sleeveless knit V-neck vest over a pale dusty-rose shirt with pointed collar and dark navy tie, shoulders/chest clipped by source edges; no hat or pipe. Soft upper-left light and complete dark-grey painted gradient backdrop; no separate photo card, notes or frame. Alpha243..255 is measured near-opaque edge variation; preserve the full painted rectangle, not a transparent portrait cutout. Fine lens reflections, moustache hair counts and knit weave remain source-resolution limits under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Short brown textured hair with raised swept crown/quiff, thick dark eyebrows, large round thin gold-wire spectacles and visible light dark upper-lip moustache/stubble. Distinct red-brown vertical cheek scar descends on screen-left beneath spectacle; do not replace it with decoration. Single modest mouth holds a short brown cigar toward screen-right, glowing tip and curling grey smoke above it. Three-quarter head toward screen-right with restrained expression. Warm brown notched jacket, pale grey/beige buttoned shirt open at collar without tie, pale folded pocket square at screen-left; bust cropped lower/sides. Upper-left soft light, complete smoky grey painted background with no separate card/frame/note. Alpha255 throughout. Individual moustache strands, cigar wrapper lettering/texture and exact scar microstructure are unreadable; preserve the visible feature groups without invention under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Neatly swept wavy short dark hair with grey streaks, dark hairy brows and a clearly visible thin brown moustache above the restrained single closed/near-closed mouth; no full beard. Single round gold-rim monocle on screen-left eye with thin cord looping down beside cheek toward collar; reddish vertical cheek scar visible beneath that monocle. Keep the other eye uncovered, no two-lens glasses. Three-quarter face/gaze toward screen-right. Dark slate-grey sleeveless V-neck knitted vest over white/light-grey pointed collar shirt and burgundy tie, bust cropped on bottom/sides, whole hairstyle visible. Soft upper-left light and complete dark grey painted backdrop; no separate card, frame, handwritten notes or exterior transparency. Alpha243..255 is source near-opacity, not a cutout. Exact monocle cord microtexture, scar edge pixels and sparse facial-hair strands are evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1; do not invent detail.
